title: DORA Metrics Dashboards for Engineering Teams | Faros

hero.headline: Improve performance and outcomes
hero.subhead: Measure industry-standard KPIs for software engineering velocity and quality with accurate, granular, correctly attributed DORA metrics.

sections.heading: Why Faros — accurate team-level DORA
sections.body: Integrates with task/CI-CD/source/incident tools including homegrown; out-of-the-box dashboards in minutes; metrics from the complete lifecycle of every change; correct attribution even in a monorepo; per-team thresholds; AI summaries; unlimited history; GDPR/SOC2/ISO27001; SaaS/hybrid/on-prem.

sections.heading: Our solution
sections.body: Trace every code change idea-to-production; improve DORA with personalized insights (slice by real org chart, overlay survey data, threshold alerts); benchmark with cross-org scorecards color-coded by latest benchmarks.

notes: Retrieved via Claude-in-Chrome. DORA Metrics is a distinct, clearly-shipped named capability under Developer Productivity / Observe.
